(cd \"$APP\" && go build -o \"$BIN\" ./cmd/ddkstat); then\n    echo \"error: go build ./cmd/ddkstat failed at the application root $APP.\" >&2\n    echo \"The deliverable is a Go module whose main package is ./cmd/ddkstat.\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\nPASSED=0\nFAILED=0\n\n# check <id> <expected exit> <ddkstat args...>  — expected standard output on stdin.\ncheck() {\n    id=$1\n    want_rc=$2\n    shift 2\n    cat > \"$WORK/want\"\n    (cd \"$APP\" && \"$BIN\" \"$@\") > \"$WORK/got\" 2> \"$WORK/err\"\n    rc=$?\n    if [ \"$rc\" -eq \"$want_rc\" ] && cmp -s \"$WORK/want\" \"$WORK/got\"; then\n        PASSED=$((PASSED + 1))\n        echo \"PASS $id: ddkstat $*\"\n    else\n        FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))\n        echo \"FAIL $id: ddkstat $*\"\n        echo \"  exit: expected $want_rc, got $rc\"\n        diff \"$WORK/want\" \"$WORK/got\" | sed 's/^/  /'\n        sed 's/^/  stderr: /' \"$WORK/err\"\n    fi\n}\n\n# ── A. (cd \"$APP\" && go build -o \"$BIN\" ./cmd/ddkstat); then\n    echo \"error: go build ./cmd/ddkstat failed at the application root $APP.\" >&2\n    echo \"The deliverable is a Go module whose main package is ./cmd/ddkstat.\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\nPASSED=0\nFAILED=0\n\n# check <id> <expected exit> <ddkstat args...>  — expected standard output on stdin.\ncheck() {\n    id=$1\n    want_rc=$2\n    shift 2\n    cat > \"$WORK/want\"\n    (cd \"$APP\" && \"$BIN\" \"$@\") > \"$WORK/got\" 2> \"$WORK/err\"\n    rc=$?\n    if [ \"$rc\" -eq \"$want_rc\" ] && cmp -s \"$WORK/want\" \"$WORK/got\"; then\n        PASSED=$((PASSED + 1))\n        echo \"PASS $id: ddkstat $*\"\n    else\n        FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))\n        echo \"FAIL $id: ddkstat $*\"\n        echo \"  exit: expected $want_rc, got $rc\"\n        diff \"$WORK/want\" \"$WORK/got\" | sed 's/^/  /'\n        sed 's/^/  stderr: /' \"$WORK/err\"\n    fi\n}\n\n# ── A. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01AquzHWsj8P5wwPCnYwqRKG","type":"tool_result","content":"// Package logread reads Drydock's JSON Lines LLM execution log into Records.\n//\n// It never writes to the log it reads. Blank lines are ignored; malformed, incomplete and\n// duplicate lines are skipped with a diagnostic on the warning writer.\npackage logread\n\nimport (\n\t\"bufio\"\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\n// Record is one execution from the log, normalized for reporting.\ntype Record struct {\n\tExecutionID    string\n\tStartedAt      string\n\tDate           string\n\tStatus         string\n\tFailed         bool\n\tCommand        string\n\tTarget         string\n\tProvider       string\n\tRequestedModel string\n\tModel          string\n\tInputTokens    int64\n\tCachedTokens   int64\n\tOutputTokens   int64\n\tCostUSD        float64\n\tElapsedMS      int64\n\tReturnCode     *int\n\tTimedOut       bool\n}\n\n// Skip describes one physical line that Read did not keep.\ntype Skip struct {\n\tLine   int    // 1-based physical line number, counting blank lines\n\tReason string // why the line was skipped\n}\n\n// Result is what Read produced from a log: the decoded records and the skipped lines.\ntype Result struct {\n\tRecords []Record\n\tSkipped int\n\tSkips   []Skip\n}\n\n// wireLine mirrors one JSON Lines object. Absent fields decode to their zero value.\ntype wireLine struct {\n\tExecutionID string `json:\"execution_id\"`\n\tStartedAt   string `json:\"started_at\"`\n\tStatus      string `json:\"status\"`\n\tJob         struct {\n\t\tCommandName string `json:\"command_name\"`\n\t\tTarget      string `json:\"target\"`\n\t\tLLM         string `json:\"llm\"`\n\t\tModel       string `json:\"model\"`\n\t} `json:\"job\"`\n\tResult struct {\n\t\tReturnCode *int `json:\"returncode\"`\n\t\tTimedOut   bool `json:\"timed_out\"`\n\t\tStats      struct {\n\t\t\tCachedInputTokens int64   `json:\"cached_input_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tElapsedMS         int64   `json:\"elapsed_ms\"`\n\t\t\tInputTokens       int64   `json:\"input_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tOutputTokens      int64   `json:\"output_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tCostUSD           float64 `json:\"cost_usd\"`\n\t\t\tModel             string  `json:\"model\"`\n\t\t} `json:\"stats\"`\n\t} `json:\"result\"`\n}\n\n// Read decodes every non-blank line of r as one log record. Malformed, incomplete and duplicate\n// lines are counted in Result.Skipped, listed in Result.Skips and described on warn. A duplicate\n// is a later line whose execution_id an earlier kept line already registered. The error is non-nil\n// only when reading from r fails.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader, warn io.Writer) (Result, error) {\n\tif warn == nil {\n\t\twarn = io.Discard\n\t}\n\tvar res Result\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n\tbr := bufio.NewReader(r)\n\tfor lineNo := 1; ; lineNo++ {\n\t\tline, err := br.ReadBytes('\\n')\n\t\tif trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(line); len(trimmed) > 0 {\n\t\t\trec, perr := parseLine(trimmed)\n\t\t\tif perr == nil && seen[rec.ExecutionID] {\n\t\t\t\tperr = errors.New(\"duplicate execution_id\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif perr != nil {\n\t\t\t\tres.Skipped++\n\t\t\t\tres.Skips = append(res.Skips, Skip{Line: lineNo, Reason: perr.Error()})\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"line %d: skipped: %v\\n\", lineNo, perr)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tseen[rec.ExecutionID] = true\n\t\t\t\tres.Records = append(res.Records, rec)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n\t\t\treturn res, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn res, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record. It fails when the line\n// is not a JSON object or when a required field is absent, empty or not a string.\nfunc parseLine(data []byte) (Record, error) {\n\tif data[0] != '{' {\n\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not a JSON object\")\n\t}\n\tvar w wireLine\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &w); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\trequired := []struct{ name, value string }{\n\t\t{\"execution_id\", w.ExecutionID},\n\t\t{\"started_at\", w.StartedAt},\n\t\t{\"status\", w.Status},\n\t\t{\"job.command_name\", w.Job.CommandName},\n\t\t{\"job.target\", w.Job.Target},\n\t}\n\tfor _, field := range required {\n\t\tif field.value == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn Record{}, fmt.Errorf(\"missing or empty %s\", field.name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn Record{\n\t\tExecutionID:    w.ExecutionID,\n\t\tStartedAt:      w.StartedAt,\n\t\tDate:           firstRunes(w.StartedAt, 10),\n\t\tStatus:         w.Status,\n\t\tFailed:         w.Status != \"succeeded\",\n\t\tCommand:        w.Job.CommandName,\n\t\tTarget:         w.Job.Target,\n\t\tProvider:       w.Job.LLM,\n\t\tRequestedModel: w.Job.Model,\n\t\tModel:          w.Result.Stats.Model,\n\t\tInputTokens:    w.Result.Stats.InputTokens,\n\t\tCachedTokens:   w.Result.Stats.CachedInputTokens,\n\t\tOutputTokens:   w.Result.Stats.OutputTokens,\n\t\tCostUSD:        w.Result.Stats.CostUSD,\n\t\tElapsedMS:      w.Result.Stats.ElapsedMS,\n\t\tReturnCode:     w.Result.ReturnCode,\n\t\tTimedOut:       w.Result.TimedOut,\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// firstRunes returns the first n characters of s, or all of s when it is shorter.\nfunc firstRunes(s string, n int) string {\n\tr := []rune(s)\n\tif len(r) > n {\n\t\tr = r[:n]\n\t}\n\treturn string(r)\n}\n======\npackage logread_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n)\n\n// entry builds one JSON Lines object with the fields Read consumes.\nfunc entry(id, status, startedAt string) string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(`{\"schema_version\":1,\"execution_id\":%q,\"started_at\":%q,\"status\":%q,`+\n\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"build\",\"target\":\"Toml\",\"llm\":\"claude\",\"model\":\"haiku\"},`+\n\t\t`\"result\":{\"returncode\":0,\"timed_out\":false,\"stats\":{\"input_tokens\":10,\"cached_input_tokens\":20,`+\n\t\t`\"output_tokens\":30,\"cost_usd\":0.5,\"elapsed_ms\":40,\"model\":\"claude-haiku-5-5\"}}}`,\n\t\tid, startedAt, status)\n}\n\nfunc read(t *testing.T, input string) logread.Result {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tres, err := logread.Read(strings.NewReader(input), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Read: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn res\n}\n\nfunc TestReadBlankLines(t *testing.T) {\n\tinput := \"\\n\" +\n\t\t\"   \\n\" +\n\t\tentry(\"a\", \"succeeded\", \"2026-10-14T06:37:54.176Z\") + \"\\n\" +\n\t\t\"\\t\\n\" +\n\t\t\"\\n\" +\n\t\tentry(\"b\", \"succeeded\", \"2026-10-15T06:37:54.176Z\") + \"\\n\" +\n\t\t\"\\n\"\n\tres := read(t, input)\n\tif len(res.Records) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"records = %d, want 2\", len(res.Records))\n\t}\n\tif res.Records[0].ExecutionID != \"a\" || res.Records[1].ExecutionID != \"b\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"ids = %q, %q; want a, b\", res.Records[0].ExecutionID, res.Records[1].ExecutionID)\n\t}\n\tif res.Skipped != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"skipped = %d, want 0 (blank lines are not skips)\", res.Skipped)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadBlankOnlyInput(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := read(t, \"\\n\\n   \\n\")\n\tif len(res.Records) != 0 || res.Skipped != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"got %d records, %d skipped; want 0, 0\", len(res.Records), res.Skipped)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadEmptyInput(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := read(t, \"\")\n\tif len(res.Records) != 0 || res.Skipped != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"got %d records, %d skipped; want 0, 0\", len(res.Records), res.Skipped)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadLastLineWithoutNewline(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := read(t, entry(\"a\", \"succeeded\", \"2026-10-14T06:37:54.176Z\"))\n\tif len(res.Records) != 1 Package logread reads Drydock's JSON Lines LLM execution log into Records.\n//\n// It never writes to the log it reads. Blank lines are ignored; malformed, incomplete and\n// duplicate lines are skipped with a diagnostic on the warning writer.\npackage logread\n\nimport (\n\t\"bufio\"\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\n// Record is one execution from the log, normalized for reporting.\ntype Record struct {\n\tExecutionID    string\n\tStartedAt      string\n\tDate           string\n\tStatus         string\n\tFailed         bool\n\tCommand        string\n\tTarget         string\n\tProvider       string\n\tRequestedModel string\n\tModel          string\n\tInputTokens    int64\n\tCachedTokens   int64\n\tOutputTokens   int64\n\tCostUSD        float64\n\tElapsedMS      int64\n\tReturnCode     *int\n\tTimedOut       bool\n}\n\n// Skip describes one physical line that Read did not keep.\ntype Skip struct {\n\tLine   int    // 1-based physical line number, counting blank lines\n\tReason string // why the line was skipped\n}\n\n// Result is what Read produced from a log: the decoded records and the skipped lines.\ntype Result struct {\n\tRecords []Record\n\tSkipped int\n\tSkips   []Skip\n}\n\n// wireLine mirrors one JSON Lines object. Absent fields decode to their zero value.\ntype wireLine struct {\n\tExecutionID string `json:\"execution_id\"`\n\tStartedAt   string `json:\"started_at\"`\n\tStatus      string `json:\"status\"`\n\tJob         struct {\n\t\tCommandName string `json:\"command_name\"`\n\t\tTarget      string `json:\"target\"`\n\t\tLLM         string `json:\"llm\"`\n\t\tModel       string `json:\"model\"`\n\t} `json:\"job\"`\n\tResult struct {\n\t\tReturnCode *int `json:\"returncode\"`\n\t\tTimedOut   bool `json:\"timed_out\"`\n\t\tStats      struct {\n\t\t\tCachedInputTokens int64   `json:\"cached_input_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tElapsedMS         int64   `json:\"elapsed_ms\"`\n\t\t\tInputTokens       int64   `json:\"input_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tOutputTokens      int64   `json:\"output_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tCostUSD           float64 `json:\"cost_usd\"`\n\t\t\tModel             string  `json:\"model\"`\n\t\t} `json:\"stats\"`\n\t} `json:\"result\"`\n}\n\n// Read decodes every non-blank line of r as one log record. Malformed, incomplete and duplicate\n// lines are counted in Result.Skipped, listed in Result.Skips and described on warn. A duplicate\n// is a later line whose execution_id an earlier kept line already registered. The error is non-nil\n// only when reading from r fails.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader, warn io.Writer) (Result, error) {\n\tif warn == nil {\n\t\twarn = io.Discard\n\t}\n\tvar res Result\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n\tbr := bufio.NewReader(r)\n\tfor lineNo := 1; ; lineNo++ {\n\t\tline, err := br.ReadBytes('\\n')\n\t\tif trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(line); len(trimmed) > 0 {\n\t\t\trec, perr := parseLine(trimmed)\n\t\t\tif perr == nil && seen[rec.ExecutionID] {\n\t\t\t\tperr = errors.New(\"duplicate execution_id\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif perr != nil {\n\t\t\t\tres.Skipped++\n\t\t\t\tres.Skips = append(res.Skips, Skip{Line: lineNo, Reason: perr.Error()})\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"line %d: skipped: %v\\n\", lineNo, perr)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tseen[rec.ExecutionID] = true\n\t\t\t\tres.Records = append(res.Records, rec)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n\t\t\treturn res, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn res, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record. It fails when the line\n// is not a JSON object or when a required field is absent, empty or not a string.\nfunc parseLine(data []byte) (Record, error) {\n\tif data[0] != '{' {\n\t\treturn Record{}, }{\n\t\t{\"execution_id\", w.ExecutionID},\n\t\t{\"started_at\", w.StartedAt},\n\t\t{\"status\", w.Status},\n\t\t{\"job.command_name\", w.Job.CommandName},\n\t\t{\"job.target\", w.Job.Target},\n\t}\n\tfor _, field := range required {\n\t\tif field.value == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn Record{}, fmt.Errorf(\"missing or empty %s\", field.name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn Record{\n\t\tExecutionID:    w.ExecutionID,\n\t\tStartedAt:      w.StartedAt,\n\t\tDate:           firstRunes(w.StartedAt, 10),\n\t\tStatus:         w.Status,\n\t\tFailed:         w.Status != \"succeeded\",\n\t\tCommand:        w.Job.CommandName,\n\t\tTarget:         w.Job.Target,\n\t\tProvider:       w.Job.LLM,\n\t\tRequestedModel: w.Job.Model,\n\t\tModel: {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017eAZhkxsdRTs5DDnWHLruH","type":"tool_result","content":"// Command ddkstat reports on Drydock's LLM execution log.\n//\n// The reporting pipeline is added by later build blocks in internal/. Until then\n// main does nothing, and it is the only package in this module that may call os.Exit.\npackage main\n\nfunc main() {}\n=====\npackage main\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// moduleRoot is the application root, two directories above this package.\nconst moduleRoot = \"../..\"\n\nfunc TestGoModDeclaresModuleAndGoVersion(t *testing.T) {\n\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(moduleRoot + \"/go.mod\")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"read go.mod: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tvar module, goVersion string\n\tvar requires int\n\tfor _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), \"\\n\") {\n\t\tfields := strings.Fields(line)\n\t\tif len(fields) == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch fields[0] {\n\t\tcase \"module\":\n\t\t\tmodule = fields[1]\n\t\tcase \"go\":\n\t\t\tgoVersion = fields[1]\n\t\tcase \"require\":\n\t\t\trequires++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif module != \"ddkstat\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"module = %q, want %q\", module, \"ddkstat\")\n\t}\n\tvar major, minor int\n\tif _, err := fmt.Sscanf(goVersion, \"%d.%d\", &major, &minor); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"go directive %q is not major.minor: %v\", goVersion, err)\n\t}\n\tif major < 1 || (major == 1 && minor < 22) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"go directive = %q, want 1.22 or newer\", goVersion)\n\t}\n\tif requires != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"found %d require directives, want none\", requires)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestLayoutDirectoriesExist(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, dir := range []string{\"cmd/ddkstat\", \"internal\", \"bin\"} {\n\t\tinfo, err := os.Stat(moduleRoot + \"/\" + dir)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"stat %s: %v\", dir, err)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !info.IsDir() {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s is not a directory\", dir)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestNoVendorOrDependencySums(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := os.Stat(moduleRoot + \"/vendor\"); err == nil {\n\t\tt.Error(\"vendor directory exists, want none\")\n\t}\n\tsum, err := os.ReadFile(moduleRoot + \"/go.sum\")\n\tif err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(string(sum)) != \"\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"go.sum is not empty: %q\", sum)\n\t}\n}\n=====\n// Package cli parses and validates ddkstat invocations.\n//\n// ParseArgs performs no I/O and never exits the process.\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"time\"\n)\n\n// Options is a validated ddkstat invocation.\ntype Options struct {\n\tReport  string\n\tTarget  string\n\tSince   string\n\tUntil   string\n\tLogPath string\n}\n\n// UsageError reports an invocation that does not match the ddkstat command line.\ntype UsageError struct {\n\tMsg string\n}\n\nfunc (e *UsageError) Error() string { return e.Msg }\n\nfunc usageErrorf(format string, args ...any) error {\n\treturn &UsageError{Msg: fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)}\n}\n\nvar knownReports = map[string]bool{\n\t\"summary\":  true,\n\t\"commands\": true,\n\t\"targets\":  true,\n\t\"models\":   true,\n\t\"daily\":    true,\n\t\"failures\": true,\n}\n\n// checkDate requires value to be a real calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD. Parsing alone is not\n// enough: time.Parse accepts shapes such as 2026-1-5, so the value must also round-trip exactly.\nfunc checkDate(name, value string) error {\n\tparsed, err := time.Parse(dateLayout, value)\n\tif err != nil || parsed.Format(dateLayout) != value {\n\t\treturn usageErrorf(\"option %s needs a YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, got %q\", name, value)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nconst dateLayout = \"2006-01-02\"\n\n// ParseArgs parses the arguments that follow the program name into Options. The order is fixed:\n// the report name, then any --target, --since or --until options, then exactly one log path.\n// Every failure is a *UsageError.\nfunc ParseArgs(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tif len(args) == 0 {\n\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"missing report name\")\n\t}\n\tif !knownReports[args[0]] {\n\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"unknown report %q\", args[0])\n\t}\n\topts := Options{Report: args[0]}\n\n\ti := 1\n\tfor ; i < len(args) && strings.HasPrefix(args[i], \"--\"); i += 2 {\n\t\tname := args[i]\n\t\tswitch name {\n\t\tcase \"--target\", \"--since\", \"--until\":\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"unknown option %q\", name)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif i+1 >= len(args) {\n\t\t\treturn Options{}, usageErrorf(\"option %s needs a value\", name)\n\t\t}\n\t\tvalue := args[i+1]\n\t\tswitch name {\n\t\tcase \"--target\":\n\t\t\topts.Target = value\n\t\tcase \"--since\":","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"eacaac68-6cca-4c1c-8f58-094e19cad684","uuid":"e5fa7a90-f88d-497e-829a-7aa1c9e9dd09","timestamp":"2026-10-26T15:39:59.758Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"// Command ddkstat reports on Drydock's LLM execution log.\n//\n// The reporting pipeline is added by later build blocks in internal/. Every other field is kept raw and decoded leniently by parseLine, so a\n// value of the wrong JSON type never costs the whole line.\ntype wireLine struct {\n\tExecutionID string `json:\"execution_id\"`\n\tStartedAt   string `json:\"started_at\"`\n\tStatus      string `json:\"status\"`\n\tJob         struct {\n\t\tCommandName string          `json:\"command_name\"`\n\t\tTarget      string          `json:\"target\"`\n\t\tLLM         json.RawMessage `json:\"llm\"`\n\t\tModel       json.RawMessage `json:\"model\"`\n\t} `json:\"job\"`\n\tResult json.RawMessage `json:\"result\"`\n}\n\n// wireResult mirrors the result object. Each member is raw; see wireLine.\ntype wireResult struct {\n\tReturnCode json.RawMessage `json:\"returncode\"`\n\tTimedOut   json.RawMessage `json:\"timed_out\"`\n\tStats      json.RawMessage `json:\"stats\"`\n}\n\n// wireStats mirrors the result.stats object. Each member is raw; see wireLine.\ntype wireStats struct {\n\tCachedInputTokens json.RawMessage `json:\"cached_input_tokens\"`\n\tElapsedMS         json.RawMessage `json:\"elapsed_ms\"`\n\tInputTokens       json.RawMessage `json:\"input_tokens\"`\n\tOutputTokens      json.RawMessage `json:\"output_tokens\"`\n\tCostUSD           json.RawMessage `json:\"cost_usd\"`\n\tModel             json.RawMessage `json:\"model\"`\n}","originalFile":"// Package logread reads Drydock's JSON Lines LLM execution log into Records.\n//\n// It never writes to the log it reads. Blank lines are ignored; malformed, incomplete and\n// duplicate lines are skipped with a diagnostic on the warning writer.\npackage logread\n\nimport (\n\t\"bufio\"\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\n// Record is one execution from the log, normalized for reporting.\ntype Record struct {\n\tExecutionID    string\n\tStartedAt      string\n\tDate           string\n\tStatus         string\n\tFailed         bool\n\tCommand        string\n\tTarget         string\n\tProvider       string\n\tRequestedModel string\n\tModel          string\n\tInputTokens    int64\n\tCachedTokens   int64\n\tOutputTokens   int64\n\tCostUSD        float64\n\tElapsedMS      int64\n\tReturnCode     *int\n\tTimedOut       bool\n}\n\n// Skip describes one physical line that Read did not keep.\ntype Skip struct {\n\tLine   int    // 1-based physical line number, counting blank lines\n\tReason string // why the line was skipped\n}\n\n// Result is what Read produced from a log: the decoded records and the skipped lines.\ntype Result struct {\n\tRecords []Record\n\tSkipped int\n\tSkips   []Skip\n}\n\n// wireLine mirrors one JSON Lines object. Absent fields decode to their zero value.\ntype wireLine struct {\n\tExecutionID string `json:\"execution_id\"`\n\tStartedAt   string `json:\"started_at\"`\n\tStatus      string `json:\"status\"`\n\tJob         struct {\n\t\tCommandName string `json:\"command_name\"`\n\t\tTarget      string `json:\"target\"`\n\t\tLLM         string `json:\"llm\"`\n\t\tModel       string `json:\"model\"`\n\t} `json:\"job\"`\n\tResult struct {\n\t\tReturnCode *int `json:\"returncode\"`\n\t\tTimedOut   bool `json:\"timed_out\"`\n\t\tStats      struct {\n\t\t\tCachedInputTokens int64   `json:\"cached_input_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tElapsedMS         int64   `json:\"elapsed_ms\"`\n\t\t\tInputTokens       int64   `json:\"input_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tOutputTokens      int64   `json:\"output_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tCostUSD           float64 `json:\"cost_usd\"`\n\t\t\tModel             string  `json:\"model\"`\n\t\t} `json:\"stats\"`\n\t} `json:\"result\"`\n}\n\n// Read decodes every non-blank line of r as one log record. Malformed, incomplete and duplicate\n// lines are counted in Result.Skipped, listed in Result.Skips and described on warn. A duplicate\n// is a later line whose execution_id an earlier kept line already registered. The error is non-nil\n// only when reading from r fails.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader, warn io.Writer) (Result, error) {\n\tif warn == nil {\n\t\twarn = io.Discard\n\t}\n\tvar res Result\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n\tbr := bufio.NewReader(r)\n\tfor lineNo := 1; ; lineNo++ {\n\t\tline, err := br.ReadBytes('\\n')\n\t\tif trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(line); len(trimmed) > 0 {\n\t\t\trec, perr := parseLine(trimmed)\n\t\t\tif perr == nil && seen[rec.ExecutionID] {\n\t\t\t\tperr = errors.New(\"duplicate execution_id\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif perr != nil {\n\t\t\t\tres.Skipped++\n\t\t\t\tres.Skips = append(res.Skips, Skip{Line: lineNo, Reason: perr.Error()})\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"line %d: skipped: %v\\n\", lineNo, perr)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tseen[rec.ExecutionID] = true\n\t\t\t\tres.Records = append(res.Records, rec)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n\t\t\treturn res, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn res, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record. It fails when the line\n// is not a JSON object or when a required field is absent, empty or not a string.\nfunc parseLine(data []byte) (Record, error) {\n\tif data[0] != '{' {\n\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not a JSON object\")\n\t}\n\tvar w wireLine\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &w); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\trequired := []struct{ name, value string }{\n\t\t{\"execution_id\", w.ExecutionID},\n\t\t{\"started_at\", w.StartedAt},\n\t\t{\"status\", w.Status},\n\t\t{\"job.command_name\", w.Job.CommandName},\n\t\t{\"job.target\", w.Job.Target},\n\t}\n\tfor _, field := range required {\n\t\tif field.value == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn Record{}, fmt.Errorf(\"missing or empty %s\", field.name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn Record{\n\t\tExecutionID:    w.ExecutionID,\n\t\tStartedAt:      w.StartedAt,\n\t\tDate:           firstRunes(w.StartedAt, 10),\n\t\tStatus:         w.Status,\n\t\tFailed:         w.Status != \"succeeded\",\n\t\tCommand:        w.Job.CommandName,\n\t\tTarget:         w.Job.Target,\n\t\tProvider:       w.Job.LLM,\n\t\tRequestedModel: w.Job.Model,\n\t\tModel:          w.Result.Stats.Model,\n\t\tInputTokens:    w.Result.Stats.InputTokens,\n\t\tCachedTokens:   w.Result.Stats.CachedInputTokens,\n\t\tOutputTokens:   w.Result.Stats.OutputTokens,\n\t\tCostUSD:        w.Result.Stats.CostUSD,\n\t\tElapsedMS:      w.Result.Stats.ElapsedMS,\n\t\tReturnCode:     w.Result.ReturnCode,\n\t\tTimedOut:       w.Result.TimedOut,\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// firstRunes returns the first n characters of s, or all of s when it is shorter.\nfunc firstRunes(s string, n int) string {\n\tr := []rune(s)\n\tif len(r) > n {\n\t\tr = r[:n]\n\t}\n\treturn string(r)\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":47,"oldLines":31,"newStart":47,"newLines":39,"lines":["   Skips   []Skip"," }"," ","-// wireLine mirrors one JSON Lines object. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgR6pu3vhmntDoAvn9Maa","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01W1xbco73ub98GEA7JveEDd","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/logread/logread.go","old_string":"// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record. It fails when the line\n// is not a JSON object or when a required field is absent, empty or not a string.\nfunc parseLine(data []byte) (Record, error) {\n\tif data[0] != '{' {\n\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not a JSON object\")\n\t}\n\tvar w wireLine\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &w); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\trequired := []struct{ name, value string }{\n\t\t{\"execution_id\", w.ExecutionID},\n\t\t{\"started_at\", w.StartedAt},\n\t\t{\"status\", w.Status},\n\t\t{\"job.command_name\", w.Job.CommandName},\n\t\t{\"job.target\", w.Job.Target},\n\t}\n\tfor _, field := range required {\n\t\tif field.value == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn Record{}, fmt.Errorf(\"missing or empty %s\", field.name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn Record{\n\t\tExecutionID:    w.ExecutionID,\n\t\tStartedAt:      w.StartedAt,\n\t\tDate:           firstRunes(w.StartedAt, 10),\n\t\tStatus:         w.Status,\n\t\tFailed:         w.Status != \"succeeded\",\n\t\tCommand:        w.Job.CommandName,\n\t\tTarget:         w.Job.Target,\n\t\tProvider:       w.Job.LLM,\n\t\tRequestedModel: w.Job.Model,\n\t\tModel:          w.Result.Stats.Model,\n\t\tInputTokens:    w.Result.Stats.InputTokens,\n\t\tCachedTokens:   w.Result.Stats.CachedInputTokens,\n\t\tOutputTokens:   w.Result.Stats.OutputTokens,\n\t\tCostUSD:        w.Result.Stats.CostUSD,\n\t\tElapsedMS:      w.Result.Stats.ElapsedMS,\n\t\tReturnCode:     w.Result.ReturnCode,\n\t\tTimedOut:       w.Result.TimedOut,\n\t}, nil\n}","new_string":"// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record. It fails when the line\n// is not a JSON object or when a required field is absent, empty or not a string. Every other\n// field is optional: an absent, null or wrong-typed value takes its zero value, and a missing\n// result or stats object leaves the record with zero numbers.\n//\n// Model is result.stats.model when that is a non-empty string, otherwise job.model.\nfunc parseLine(data []byte) (Record, error) {\n\tif data[0] != '{' {\n\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not a JSON object\")\n\t}\n\tvar w wireLine\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &w); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\trequired := []struct{ name, value string }{\n\t\t{\"execution_id\", w.ExecutionID},\n\t\t{\"started_at\", w.StartedAt},\n\t\t{\"status\", w.Status},\n\t\t{\"job.command_name\", w.Job.CommandName},\n\t\t{\"job.target\", w.Job.Target},\n\t}\n\tfor _, field := range required {\n\t\tif field.value == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn Record{}, fmt.Errorf(\"missing or empty %s\", field.name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tvar res wireResult\n\tdecodeObject(w.Result, &res)\n\tvar stats wireStats\n\tdecodeObject(res.Stats, &stats)\n\n\trequested := stringValue(w.Job.Model)\n\tmodel := stringValue(stats.Model)\n\tif model == \"\" {\n\t\tmodel = requested\n\t}\n\treturn Record{\n\t\tExecutionID:    w.ExecutionID,\n\t\tStartedAt:      w.StartedAt,\n\t\tDate:           firstRunes(w.StartedAt, 10),\n\t\tStatus:         w.Status,\n\t\tFailed:         w.Status != \"succeeded\",\n\t\tCommand:        w.Job.CommandName,\n\t\tTarget:         w.Job.Target,\n\t\tProvider:       stringValue(w.Job.LLM),\n\t\tRequestedModel: requested,\n\t\tModel:          model,\n\t\tInputTokens:    intValue(stats.InputTokens),\n\t\tCachedTokens:   intValue(stats.CachedInputTokens),\n\t\tOutputTokens:   intValue(stats.OutputTokens),\n\t\tCostUSD:        floatValue(stats.CostUSD),\n\t\tElapsedMS:      intValue(stats.ElapsedMS),\n\t\tReturnCode:     returnCode(res.ReturnCode),\n\t\tTimedOut:       boolValue(res.TimedOut),\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// decodeObject decodes raw into v when raw holds a JSON object. Absent, null and non-object values\n// leave v at its zero value.\nfunc decodeObject(raw json.RawMessage, v any) {\n\tif len(raw) > 0 {\n\t\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, v)\n\t}\n}\n\n// intValue returns raw as an int64, or zero when raw is absent, null or not an integer.\nfunc intValue(raw json.RawMessage) int64 {\n\tvar n int64\n\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &n)\n\treturn n\n}\n\n// floatValue returns raw as a float64, or zero when raw is absent, null or not a number.\nfunc floatValue(raw json.RawMessage) float64 {\n\tvar f float64\n\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &f)\n\treturn f\n}\n\n// stringValue returns raw as a string, or the empty string when raw is absent, null or not a string.\nfunc stringValue(raw json.RawMessage) string {\n\tvar s string\n\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &s)\n\treturn s\n}\n\n// boolValue returns raw as a bool, or false when raw is absent, null or not a bool.\nfunc boolValue(raw json.RawMessage) bool {\n\tvar b bool\n\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &b)\n\treturn b\n}\n\n// returnCode returns raw as a return code. It is nil when raw is absent, null or not an integer.\nfunc returnCode(raw json.RawMessage) *int {\n\tvar n int\n\tif json.Unmarshal(raw, &n) != nil || string(raw) == \"null\" {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\treturn &n\n}"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":8109,"cache_read_input_tokens":34259,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":8109},"output_tokens":16,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"eacaac68-6cca-4c1c-8f58-094e19cad684","uuid":"421f359e-fb1c-4bf8-92b0-f3a2290f6d78","timestamp":"2026-10-26T15:40:44.992Z","request_id":"req_011CgR6pthqjdjZMA8CvReYX","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01W1xbco73ub98GEA7JveEDd":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/logread/logread.go","old_string":"// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record. Blank lines are ignored; malformed, incomplete and\n// duplicate lines are skipped with a diagnostic on the warning writer.\npackage logread\n\nimport (\n\t\"bufio\"\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\n// Record is one execution from the log, normalized for reporting.\ntype Record struct {\n\tExecutionID    string\n\tStartedAt      string\n\tDate           string\n\tStatus         string\n\tFailed         bool\n\tCommand        string\n\tTarget         string\n\tProvider       string\n\tRequestedModel string\n\tModel          string\n\tInputTokens    int64\n\tCachedTokens   int64\n\tOutputTokens   int64\n\tCostUSD        float64\n\tElapsedMS      int64\n\tReturnCode     *int\n\tTimedOut       bool\n}\n\n// Skip describes one physical line that Read did not keep.\ntype Skip struct {\n\tLine   int    // 1-based physical line number, counting blank lines\n\tReason string // why the line was skipped\n}\n\n// Result is what Read produced from a log: the decoded records and the skipped lines.\ntype Result struct {\n\tRecords []Record\n\tSkipped int\n\tSkips   []Skip\n}\n\n// wireLine mirrors one JSON Lines object. The required string fields are typed so that a wrong\n// type skips the line. Every other field is kept raw and decoded leniently by parseLine, so a\n// value of the wrong JSON type never costs the whole line.\ntype wireLine struct {\n\tExecutionID string `json:\"execution_id\"`\n\tStartedAt   string `json:\"started_at\"`\n\tStatus      string `json:\"status\"`\n\tJob         struct {\n\t\tCommandName string          `json:\"command_name\"`\n\t\tTarget      string          `json:\"target\"`\n\t\tLLM         json.RawMessage `json:\"llm\"`\n\t\tModel       json.RawMessage `json:\"model\"`\n\t} `json:\"job\"`\n\tResult json.RawMessage `json:\"result\"`\n}\n\n// wireResult mirrors the result object. Each member is raw; see wireLine.\ntype wireResult struct {\n\tReturnCode json.RawMessage `json:\"returncode\"`\n\tTimedOut   json.RawMessage `json:\"timed_out\"`\n\tStats      json.RawMessage `json:\"stats\"`\n}\n\n// wireStats mirrors the result.stats object. Each member is raw; see wireLine.\ntype wireStats struct {\n\tCachedInputTokens json.RawMessage `json:\"cached_input_tokens\"`\n\tElapsedMS         json.RawMessage `json:\"elapsed_ms\"`\n\tInputTokens       json.RawMessage `json:\"input_tokens\"`\n\tOutputTokens      json.RawMessage `json:\"output_tokens\"`\n\tCostUSD           json.RawMessage `json:\"cost_usd\"`\n\tModel             json.RawMessage `json:\"model\"`\n}\n\n// Read decodes every non-blank line of r as one log record. Malformed, incomplete and duplicate\n// lines are counted in Result.Skipped, listed in Result.Skips and described on warn. A duplicate\n// is a later line whose execution_id an earlier kept line already registered. The error is non-nil\n// only when reading from r fails.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader, warn io.Writer) (Result, error) {\n\tif warn == nil {\n\t\twarn = io.Discard\n\t}\n\tvar res Result\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n\tbr := bufio.NewReader(r)\n\tfor lineNo := 1; ; lineNo++ {\n\t\tline, err := br.ReadBytes('\\n')\n\t\tif trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(line); len(trimmed) > 0 {\n\t\t\trec, perr := parseLine(trimmed)\n\t\t\tif perr == nil && seen[rec.ExecutionID] {\n\t\t\t\tperr = errors.New(\"duplicate execution_id\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif perr != nil {\n\t\t\t\tres.Skipped++\n\t\t\t\tres.Skips = append(res.Skips, Skip{Line: lineNo, Reason: perr.Error()})\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"line %d: skipped: %v\\n\", lineNo, perr)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tseen[rec.ExecutionID] = true\n\t\t\t\tres.Records = append(res.Records, rec)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n\t\t\treturn res, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn res, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record. It fails when the line\n// is not a JSON object or when a required field is absent, empty or not a string.\nfunc parseLine(data []byte) (Record, error) {\n\tif data[0] != '{' {\n\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not a JSON object\")\n\t}\n\tvar w wireLine\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &w); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\trequired := []struct{ name, value string }{\n\t\t{\"execution_id\", w.ExecutionID},\n\t\t{\"started_at\", w.StartedAt},\n\t\t{\"status\", w.Status},\n\t\t{\"job.command_name\", w.Job.CommandName},\n\t\t{\"job.target\", w.Job.Target},\n\t}\n\tfor _, field := range required {\n\t\tif field.value == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn Record{}, fmt.Errorf(\"missing or empty %s\", field.name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn Record{\n\t\tExecutionID:    w.ExecutionID,\n\t\tStartedAt:      w.StartedAt,\n\t\tDate:           firstRunes(w.StartedAt, 10),\n\t\tStatus:         w.Status,\n\t\tFailed:         w.Status != \"succeeded\",\n\t\tCommand:        w.Job.CommandName,\n\t\tTarget:         w.Job.Target,\n\t\tProvider:       w.Job.LLM,\n\t\tRequestedModel: w.Job.Model,\n\t\tModel:          w.Result.Stats.Model,\n\t\tInputTokens:    w.Result.Stats.InputTokens,\n\t\tCachedTokens:   w.Result.Stats.CachedInputTokens,\n\t\tOutputTokens:   w.Result.Stats.OutputTokens,\n\t\tCostUSD:        w.Result.Stats.CostUSD,\n\t\tElapsedMS:      w.Result.Stats.ElapsedMS,\n\t\tReturnCode:     w.Result.ReturnCode,\n\t\tTimedOut:       w.Result.TimedOut,\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// firstRunes returns the first n characters of s, or all of s when it is shorter.\nfunc firstRunes(s string, n int) string {\n\tr := []rune(s)\n\tif len(r) > n {\n\t\tr = r[:n]\n\t}\n\treturn string(r)\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":117,"oldLines":7,"newStart":117,"newLines":11,"lines":[" }"," "," // parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record. Before, a string in one of these fields dropped the whole line.\n- **Missing objects:** a missing or non-object `result` or `stats` still yields a kept record with zero numbers.\n- **Return code:** `returncode` that is `null` or absent is nil.\n- **Model:** `Record.Model` is `stats.model` when it is a non-empty string, otherwise `job.model`. `RequestedModel` still holds `job.model`.\n- Required string fields (`execution_id`, `started_at`, `status`, `job.command_name`, `job.target`) still skip the line when they are missing, empty, or the wrong type.\n\nTests added to `internal/logread/logread_test.go` under the names the specs require: `TestNumbersAbsentAreZero`, `TestNumbersNullAreZero`, `TestNumbersNonNumericAreZero`, `TestNoStatsObjectStillRecord`, `TestReturnCodeNullIsNil`, and the four `TestModel*` tests. A value such as `12.0` counts as zero.\n\nI did not commit anything.\n\nRESULT: SUCCESS\n\nFILES CHANGED:\n- internal/logread/logread.go\n- internal/logread/logread_test.go\n\nSUMMARY:\nImplemented log-numbers and log-model in `internal/logread`.
